title: Maus 1: A Survivor's Tale: My Father Bleeds History
author: Art Spiegelman
current_text: On January 10, 2022, the McMinn County Board of Education in Tennessee voted unanimously to remove Maus from its eighth-grade language arts curriculum, citing profanity and depictions of nudity.

sources.quote: On January 10, 2022, the McMinn County Board of Education in Tennessee voted unanimously to remove Art Spiegelman’s Maus from its eighth-grade language arts curriculum, citing its use of profanity and depictions of nudity.
sources.title: Transcript of the McMinn County Board of Education's Removal of Maus - The Comics Journal
